description_en: Deletes a provisioned CIDR block from an IP Address Manager (IPAM) pool
description_zh: 删除IPAM地址池预置的CIDR地址段
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam delete-ipam-pool-cidr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --cidr 192.168.1.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIpamPoolCidr

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the IPAM is hosted.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM托管地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned CIDR block to delete.

Only IPv4 CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的预置的CIDR地址段。

目前，只支持IPv4类型的地址段
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run. Checks parameters, syntax, and quotas and limits, with no changes being made. Returns DryRunOperation if validation succeeds; otherwise returns an error.

false (default): Sends the request. On success, returns a 2xx status and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除IPAM地址池中的CIDR地址段。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接删除
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotency. Provide a unique ASCII token generated by your client. A new token is provided for each distinct request.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID can differ for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
